## What it changes

What a user sees or can do now, in a few lines; the issue it settles, if any.

## Checked

- [ ] The test groups it touches pass (`tools/test.sh` for a change across the code)
- [ ] A fix or a merge of two ways into one has a regression test that fails before it
- [ ] Every new definition has a docstring; README, HACKING or the starter init file updated where it changes what they say
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`)
